junk_floor.head: location
junk_floor.reference_pool: the 28,072-location curation sidecar (artifacts/curation/supply_scores.jsonl), every row read through the canonical 640x360ss2 view its own stored score was taken off
junk_floor.method: volume matched on a fixed reference pool. The retired head's 0.20 passed 15,161 of 28,072 canonical reads (54.01%); this is the candidate score that passes that same count — the 15,161st largest candidate read, 0.100580 — rounded DOWN to the next 0.005, because a floor rounded up removes supply the cut it restates did not. Realized 15,182 passing (54.08%). NOT a calibration: no label was read here and nothing re-measured where junk ends on the new scale.
junk_floor.where: intake, the colorize draw; and the walk's expansion tier

great_cut.head: location
great_cut.reference_pool: the 28,072-location curation sidecar (artifacts/curation/supply_scores.jsonl), every row read through the canonical 640x360ss2 view its own stored score was taken off
great_cut.method: volume matched on a fixed reference pool. The retired head's 0.50 on P(>=4) called 3,034 of 28,072 canonical reads great (10.81%); this is the candidate score that calls that same count great — the 3,034th largest candidate P(>=4), 0.107595 — rounded DOWN to the next 0.005. Realized 3,062 (10.91%). The absolute height is low because the retrained head's top-class mass is low; it is a rank statement about this head and not a claim that these frames are 0.105-probable fours.
great_cut.where: the currency: a keeper at or above it is a class 4, weighted ten to one against a class 3

strange_render_release_bar.head: strange_render
strange_render_release_bar.method: the labels-derived crossover. Isotonic regression of P(the human said >=3) against this head's own P(>=3), over all 3,085 labeled strange_render pictures scored through the staged artifact, ties pooled, non-decreasing; the crossing is the LOWEST score whose fitted agreement reaches a half, and the bar is that crossing rounded up to the next 0.005. Crossing 0.6809, 95% cluster bootstrap over places [0.540, 0.776]; the held-out selection slice crosses at 0.6987 on its own. Declared before it was read, and the roundings go up because a bar is a floor. STILL A >=3 BAR: the head's fourth class is preferred where it appears and gates nothing.
strange_render_release_bar.where: release selection: a row below it is not seated, and a slot with no passing supply goes unfilled
strange_render_release_bar.basis: an ACTING bar by Matt's review verdict of 2026-08-17 — every one of run2's eleven released strange rows below the advisory was bad, the head was right about all eleven, and the release path that seated them was padding strange slots from thin passing supply. THAT the cut acts is that verdict; WHERE it sits is a measurement: 0.685 on a011188bbcaa, restated 2026-08-17 over all 3,085 labeled strange_render pictures, over 850 places — the labels-derived crossover.
